mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the past month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and unemployment rate indicates a stagflationary environment where the Fed is hiking rates to combat inflation while the economy weakens, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of very low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%), the labor market tightness accelerates inflationary pressures, prompting the Federal Reserve to implement aggressive monetary tightening, which subsequently depresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1400 thousand units, it signals a contraction in the residential sector, which is a leading indicator of broader economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1400, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production growth indicates expanding economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and retail sales signals a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase above 5.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers expectations of aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 5.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
